sloka: इच्छामि शीघ्रं हनुमत्प्रधानान् शाखामृगांस्तान् मगृहराजदर्पान् ।द्रष्टुं कृतार्थान् सह राघवाभ्यां श्रोतुं च सीताधिगमे प्रयत्नम् ।। ५.६३.२८ ।।।।
transliteration: icchāmi śīghraṁ hanumatpradhānān śākhāmṛgāṁstān magṛharājadarpān ।draṣṭuṁ kṛtārthān saha rāghavābhyāṁ śrotuṁ ca sītādhigame prayatnam ।। 5.63.28 ।।।।

translations.english: I long to see those triumphant monkeys led by Hanuman, proud as the king of beasts, together with Rama and Lakshmana, and to hear of their effort in finding Sita.
